## Reynolds Consumer Products to Participate in Barclays 19th Annual Global Consumer Conference


August 26, 2026


[PDF Version](https://investors.reynoldsconsumerproducts.com/node/10521/pdf)


LAKE FOREST, Ill.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Aug. 26, 2026-- Reynolds Consumer Products Inc. (the “Company”) (Nasdaq: REYN) announced that President and Chief Executive Officer, Scott Huckins, and Chief Financial Officer, Nathan Lowe, will participate in a fireside chat at the Barclays 19th Annual Global Consumer Conference on Wednesday, September 9, 2026, at 3:45 p.m. ET.


The fireside chat will be webcast live and can be accessed on the “Events & Presentations” section of the Company’s website at[https://investors.reynoldsconsumerproducts.com/](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.reynoldsconsumerproducts.com%2F&esheet=54594822&newsitemid=20260826597571&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.reynoldsconsumerproducts.com%2F&index=1&md5=1cc906ffbd80073b6e8d9608f78cbae1) . A replay of the webcast will be available following the event.


**About Reynolds Consumer Products Inc.**


Reynolds Consumer Products is a leading provider of household essentials designed to simplify daily life, so consumers can enjoy what matters most. Found in 95% of U.S. homes, the Company offers trusted solutions for cooking, serving, clean-up, and storage. Its portfolio features iconic brands like Reynolds® and Hefty®, along with store brand products tailored to retail partners. Reynolds holds the No. 1 or No. 2 market share in most of the categories it serves. Learn more at[investors.reynoldsconsumerproducts.com.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.reynoldsconsumerproducts.com%2F&esheet=54594822&newsitemid=20260826597571&lan=en-US&anchor=investors.reynoldsconsumerproducts.com.&index=2&md5=44fbd26c17015232a1b42bd08390a94a)
